reasons: **We're cutting it close on heat.** This plan gets about 71% of the most important work done, but the hottest-working crew members will come very close to the safe body-heat limit, with almost no room to spare. Watch everyone closely, enforce water and shade breaks, and stop anyone who shows signs of heat illness.
**Everyone comes inside from 1 to 3 PM.** Lightning and a severe thunderstorm are expected, so no outdoor work during that window. The plan already accounts for this lost time.

**Kofi is new and not used to the heat yet, so keep him off the heaviest jobs when it's hot.** If you want more safety room, there's a backup plan that spreads the heavy work more evenly and protects Kofi further. It keeps the crew cooler but gets a bit less done (about 67% instead of 71%).

Hard safety rules:
- Every worker's 90th percentile core temperature must stay below 38.0 °C all shift. Harder work, sun and high WBGT heat people up; 30-min shade rests cool them down.
- Breaks: at most 3 work slots in a row, then a 'rest' slot; at most 2 in a row if any of those slots has WBGT >= 30.0 °C.
- No outdoor tasks during hazards that stop outdoor work. After lightning, outdoor work stays stopped for 30 more minutes.
- Workers who are not acclimatized never do very_heavy tasks when WBGT >= 28.0 °C.
Validity: one entry per slot per worker; off-site workers rest; skills and allowed slots must match.
